facts.fact: Law n° 2016-012 of 6 May 2016 on electronic transactions, exchanges and services, published in the Journal officiel of 27 May 2016, regulates electronic commerce and gives legal effect to electronic writings, electronic signatures, electronic certificates and electronic archiving.
